quarterly_data.signal: Strategy stated in the half-year report: the company is moving from a simple-contracting order structure to a 'development-centred total solution' covering project planning, financial structuring, construction and after-management; it will pursue selective order-taking while strategically adjusting the share of high-margin self-developed projects to secure a stable operating margin, and is expanding into operation and management businesses that generate recurring cash flow. Order strategy for public building work: respond to the public tender system; M&E work: selective bidding that puts accurate cost estimates and profitability first.

R&D (consolidated): H1 2026 R&D spending KRW 1,889 million, 0.23% of revenue (FY2025: KRW 3,387 million, 0.20%). The parent's technology research team works on brand product development, new construction methods and AI design, floor-noise reduction, advanced use of drones and IoT, and testing whether technologies used in automobiles and robotics can be applied to construction.
